Leaker Evan Blass just posted claiming the iPhone Ultra will come in three colors, including a surprising red option.

Update: Mark Gurman has posted on X claiming the iPhone Ultra will NOT come in red, directly contradicting Blass. His original post is below.

Evan Blass claims the iPhone Ultra may come in red

Apple's event is officially set for September 9, and rumors about its next flagship iPhone keep coming in, with the latest being about the colors of the folding iPhone Ultra.

It's largely been agreed upon that the iPhone 18 Pro will come in deep cherry/wine red, light blue, silver, and possibly space gray.

But rumors have suggested the iPhone Ultra may only come in black and white options, or perhaps only white.

However, leaker Evan Blass has posted on X claiming there will also be a red option.

The image above appears to be AI-generated. For example, the iOS 27 status bar in the image has inconsistencies, using the old battery icon design from iOS 26.

However, even if the image is likely AI-generated, that doesn't mean the color information in it is necessarily wrong.

Since there have been no prior credible rumors about a red option for the iPhone Ultra, we're skeptical about this. It also might be unusual for both flagship models to offer a red version, so everyone should take this rumor with a grain of salt.

Either way, we'll find out what Apple has prepared in two weeks.

What do you think of the rumored colors for the iPhone Ultra? Let us know in the comments.
